body.en: Inflows: sale of fixed assets and non-current investments (full sale proceeds), interest and dividend received (non-financial company). Outflows: purchase of fixed assets, intangible assets and non-current investments. answer.en: Net cash used in investing activities ₹1,90,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Machinery net: opening 5,00,000, rupees closing 6,50,000 rupees; depreciation 50,000 rupees; a machine of book value 40,000 rupees sold for 30,000 rupees. Dividend received 20,000 rupees. Find net cash from investing activities.
Purchase equals 6,50,000 plus 50,000 plus 40,000 minus 5,00,000 equals 2,40,000 rupees outflow.
Sale proceeds 30,000 rupees (loss 10,000 rupees is added back in operating activities).
Net cash used in investing equals minus 2,40,000 plus 30,000 plus 20,000 equals (1,90,000 rupees).
So the answer is Net cash used in investing activities 1,90,000 rupees.

problem.en: Equity share capital rose from ₹10,00,000 to ₹14,00,000 (shares issued at 10% premium). 10% debentures fell from ₹5,00,000 to ₹3,00,000 (redeemed at par at the start of the year). Interest paid on debentures ₹30,000; dividend paid ₹1,00,000. Find net cash from financing activities.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Equity share capital rose from 10,00,000 rupees to 14,00,000 rupees (shares issued at 10 percent premium). 10 percent debentures fell from 5,00,000 rupees to 3,00,000 rupees (redeemed at par at the start of the year). Interest paid on debentures 30,000 rupees; dividend paid 1,00,000 rupees. Find net cash from financing activities.
Issue of shares equals 4,00,000 plus 10 percent premium 40,000 equals 4,40,000 rupees inflow.
Redemption of debentures 2,00,000 rupees; interest 30,000 rupees; dividend 1,00,000 rupees outflows.
Net cash from financing equals 4,40,000 minus 2,00,000 minus 30,000 minus 1,00,000 equals 1,10,000 rupees.
So the answer is Net cash from financing activities 1,10,000 rupees.
